product.description: Genuine OEM HP HT03XL replacement battery, 11.55V, Li-ion. Fits HP Pavilion 15-CS, 15-DA, 15-DB, 15-DW, 14-CE, 14-CF, 17-BY, 17-CA series and HP 250 G7, 255 G7 (3-cell, 41.9Wh). Also matches part numbers L11119-855, L11421-2C2, HSTNN-UB7J, HSTNN-DB8R. Tested before dispatch.

faqs.question: How do I know this battery fits my laptop?
faqs.answer: This fits HP Pavilion 15-CS, 15-DA series and HP 250 G7 (also 15-DB, 15-DW, 14-CE, 14-CF, 17-BY, 17-CA, 255 G7). Note the similarly-named TF03XL uses a different connector and is not interchangeable — the part number on your old battery is the safest way to confirm. If you're unsure, send us a photo of the sticker under your laptop on WhatsApp and we'll confirm.

faqs.question: Is this an original or compatible battery?
faqs.answer: This is a genuine original HP HT03XL unit.
